svg.title: Technical Skills
svg.desc: Languages: Java, Python, R, SQL; Backend: Spring, Spring Boot, MyBatis; Database: Oracle, MySQL; Data Analysis: NumPy, pandas, Matplotlib; Data Collection: BeautifulSoup, Selenium; Visualization & BI: Tableau, Power BI, Excel; Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Vue.js; Version Control: Git, GitHub, GitLab; Development Tools: VS Code, Spring Tool Suite (STS), Jupyter Notebook, Google Colab, MySQL Workbench
